semantics: Votion re-votes a vault's bucket only when its own re-solve is worth it. Fitted from every captured optimizer diff (votion/optimization/current.json, git history) and scored against the vote changes that followed each cast.

rule.text: re-votes a bucket when it would gain more than $0.05 AND its split differs by more than 5%

fit.source: votion/optimization/current.json, 1399 captures 2026-07-31 → 2026-09-27, periods 196-204, every vault × bucket
fit.votion_words: diff.message: 'Worth changing: X% deviation, gain $Y' / 'Keep current: only X% deviation, would gain $Y'

track_record.note: a flagged bucket of the large arbLUNA vault moved every time; the small ampLUNA vault held 8 flagged buckets (reason not in the captures). No bucket moved without the flag.

timing.typical: once per round, about 2.6 h before Votion's voteBefore (Sunday ~21:20 UTC); round 204 cast early (Wednesday)

method: votion/backtest/backtest-move-rule.py — re-run it on a tla-core clone to refresh this file
